snippet.title: Warpspeeders - SAGExpo '26 Trailer
snippet.description:
Jump and dash around enclosed levels, extend a trail that follows behind you, and cover as much distance as possible! Guide an anthropomorphic fallen star back into space!

Sonic Quartet was fun, but I think working on an original game had something I was missing. What that was, I'm still not entirely sure, but for now, I'll just say I like weird platformers.

(Oh, wait, I haven't even shown off gameplay of Sonic Quartet yet; I just have music... I can probably count the number of people who know what that is on my hands, but I wonder if I should do something with that...)

You can play the demo for Warpspeeders here: https://insanity8.itch.io/warpspeeders
You can also check out the Sonic Fan Games HQ booth here when it gets published tomorrow: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/warpspeeders-sage-26-demo.2927/
